card.name: Come into contact with
card.fires_on: The verb "come/came/comes" (or the following "in") in the phrase "come in/into contact with", right before the word contact. Seen mostly in handling instructions about materials touching a product or skin.

modes.description: Items, vials or devices that have come into contact with a drug or substance, in handling or disposal text.
